name: Thomson Reuters Corporation
sells: US public records platform (CLEAR) for authorized businesses and government agencies
CLEAR public- and proprietary-records platform licensed to law enforcement, welfare agencies, financial institutions, law firms and other authorized businesses and agencies

records sourced from 'third-party business partners (including private data providers and data brokers)', consumer reporting agencies, government entities and third-party websites (no companies named)

optOut.notes: Do-not-sell/share via the page's OneTrust link or privacy.issues@thomsonreuters.com; public-records requests to westlaw.privacypolicy@thomsonreuters.com. Thomson Reuters says it typically suppresses records only for judges, public officials, law enforcement, or people with evidence of risk of physical harm (e.g., police reports, court orders).

signals.value: 2025 revenues $7,476 million (whole company; CLEAR revenue not broken out)
